{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → Model Edit → `uAlign` (also on the Comma ribbon tab, Model Edit block)
{{% /callout %}}

Makes beams, plates, bolt arrays, control lines and more parallel (or perpendicular) to a picked face, plane or line, without changing their length.

**How to use:**

1.  Choose *Reference* (Face, Plane 3 points or Line) and *Orientation* (Parallel or Perpendicular), or tick *Rotate only*.
2.  Click **Apply**, pick the reference, then pick the targets if none were preselected. Finish with the middle mouse button.
3.  Repeat until <kbd>Esc</kbd>.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Reference** | Face, Plane 3 points or Line. |
| **Orientation** | Parallel or Perpendicular to the reference. |
| **Rotate only** | Keeps the primary axis and only rotates about it. Needs a face or plane reference. |

Plane references support Beam, PolyBeam, ContourPlate, BoltArray and ControlLine (parallel plane also supports Connection, Detail and Weld). Line references support Beam, BoltArray and ControlLine. Rotate only supports Beam, PolyBeam and BoltArray. Anything else is reported as unsupported.

**Rebar:** a SingleRebar or polygonal RebarGroup turns rigidly about its first input point, so its hooks and the distribution of a group turn with it. Parallel and Perpendicular aim the first leg of the bar by the smallest rotation (the roll is carried along), for face, plane and line references. Rotate only rolls a planar bent bar about its first leg; a straight or non-planar bar has no roll to set and is skipped. After the turn the physical bars, hooks included, are read back and must sit where the rotation predicts; otherwise the bar is turned back and listed. Component-owned bars, RebarSet bars, bars with child objects and spiral or curved groups are skipped and listed, and a RebarSet itself is not supported yet. Each bar turns about its own first point, so bars selected together with a beam do not follow that beam's rotation.

{{% callout type="warning" %}}
A native failure stops the batch; earlier changes can remain, so inspect the model and use Undo before retrying.
{{% /callout %}}

**More details:**

-   PolyBeam uses its own-axis rotation for both plane orientation labels, matching the reference behavior.
-   BooleanPart and other bolt layouts have no reference dispatch and are reported as unsupported.
-   Failed work-plane restoration is reported as an uncertain state.
-   Standard attributes load on opening.
-   Negative reference mode selects the first reference; RotateOnly and Orientation normalize to No/Yes and Parallel/Perpendicular.
-   Perpendicular is authoritative over contradictory legacy Parallel flags.
-   Normalized attributes apply without starting a model operation.
